oracle: src/local_runtime/paths.rs::peer() (SO_PEERCRED ucred.uid==geteuid) + DatabaseLease try_lock (flock LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB on fd); NM-004/NM-008 evidence

environment.note: no make/node-gyp/system install — direct gcc compile of N-API addon

artifact_sha256.linux_guards.node_note: regenerable ABI artifact — committed source + build command reproduce it; binary not committed

validated.SO_PEERCRED: REAL — getsockopt(SOL_SOCKET,SO_PEERCRED) on accepted unix-socket fd returns kernel ucred {pid,uid,gid}; uid==euid authorizes; non-socket fd rejected; cross-UID NOT_RUN (single-UID box, kernel cannot be forged)
validated.flock_fd_lease: REAL — flock(LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB) on fd owned by Node process; second OFD contention -> EWOULDBLOCK(11); external util-linux flock sees lease (exit 1) proving kernel-enforced; release on close; cross-process child -> EWOULDBLOCK; EBADF on invalid fd
validated.no_substitutes: no subprocess for the lease itself, no PID files, no skipped UID check; flock binary used only as external proof-of-enforcement

limitations: addon built for Node v20.19.2 ABI; production builds need a toolchain-capable step (prebuildify/node-gyp or pinned gcc invocation) — build recipe recorded
socket._handle.fd is a Node-internal accessor; stable on v20.19.2, flagged for re-verification on Node 24
cross-UID authorize reject path unexercised locally (kernel returns real uid only)

decision.binding: hand-rolled minimal N-API addon (linux_guards.c, ~80 lines, two functions)
decision.why: smallest maintained-dependency-free real binding; koffi FFI alternative unnecessary once headers proven present; fs-ext/proper-lockfile rejected in NM-008
